subject: MAP weekly: Taktboard integration — action tracker and evaluation plan
messages:
From: Sam Reynolds <sam.reynolds@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP weekly: Taktboard integration — checkpoints and asks

Marissa / team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Per our MAP, Taktboard is moving into the evaluation window next week and we want a lightweight weekly pulse on the integration areas: SDK/API wiring, auth/token lifecycle, streaming telemetry, and tool-calling hooks.

High-level asks for this week:
- Status on SDK auth / token refresh behavior (we need client-side guidance + server patch ETA)
- Streaming sample: can we get a small push/pull demo with live telemetry by EOD Thu 3/24?
- Tool-calling: confirm whether function schema will be stable for the eval and whether we should mock calls on our side
- Any expected blockers for the 3/30 pilot environment cutover

I've attached the latest MAP (MAP_Acme-Taktboard_v3.pdf) and our evaluation checklist (eval-checklist.xlsx) — please reference the checklist when you post updates. Can we align on a 30-min sync Tue 3/23 @ 10am PT to go through action owners?

Sam
Sam Reynolds
Director, Integrations — Taktboard
sam.reynolds@acme.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: MAP_Acme-Taktboard_v3.pdf (application/pdf), eval-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP weekly: Taktboard integration — checkpoints and asks

Thanks Sam — 10am PT on Tue works for us. Quick status and owners (action tracker below). I copied Aditya who will own token refresh work.

Action tracker (owner / due / short note):
- SDK auth patch (Aditya Rao) / due 2027-03-24 / implementing token refresh endpoint + client guidance; will push a branch + test vectors
- Streaming demo (Jonas Weber) / due 2027-03-24 / demo server + short script to replay telemetry; will provide meeting creds
- Tool-calling schema freeze (Monica Patel) / due 2027-03-26 / propose minimal function schema for eval; will raise if more fields needed
- Pilot infra cutover checklist (Marissa Cole) / due 2027-03-30 / will produce runbook and rollback plan

Meeting invite sent (Google Calendar). For visibility, the Drive links are posted in the MAP doc (see link you shared).

We will reference the eval checklist when handing over artifacts during the sync. If anything slips earlier, we'll update this thread.

Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: MAP_Acme-Taktboard_v3.pdf (updated link in Drive)

Cc: Sam Reynolds <sam.reynolds@acme.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP weekly: Taktboard integration — checkpoints and asks

Quick tech update ahead of tomorrow's sync:

SDK / Auth:
- Found that the current client retries drop the refresh token when a 401 is returned with a non-standard body; Aditya and I discussed adding an explicit token-refresh flow to the SDK (hook + example).
- Need short-lived test creds from Taktboard (client_id/client_secret + a test refresh token) — Sam, can you provide a sandbox credential set or invite redwood-infra@test-taktboard?

Streaming:
- I have a local demo server that can stream event batches and an accompanying script that replays telemetry at 10 req/s; will push a Docker image and a small runbook to the Drive link by EOD 3/22.
- One question: what retention/sequence expectations do you have for partial reconnects? Right now we plan to expose sequence ID and last-ack; if you need replay beyond 1h we should call that out now.

Tool-calling:
- Monica, I'm seeing some variance in the sample function shapes. For the evaluation, I'd propose we keep the function schema to name/inputs/outputs (flat JSON) and we'll version later. That should let Taktboard mock easily.

I'll post the Docker image ID and the small test vectors after the push.

—Jonas
Principal Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Acknowledged. I'm implementing the token-refresh endpoint and adding a small example to the SDK docs (refresh flow + error handling). Expect a PR by 2027-03-24 with test vectors and instructions to validate locally.

Test vector (short):
- POST /oauth/token 
  - body: {grant_type: "refresh_token", refresh_token: "rfrsh-test-1"} 
  - expect: 200 {access_token: "tok-test-xyz", expires_in: 3600}

I'll also include a short shell script to exercise the flow against the sandbox. If Taktboard can provide sandbox creds (Sam), Aditya will seed them into the test runbook.

—Aditya
Senior Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

- PO/invoice: our procurement asked for an itemized invoice for the evaluation scope — is billing contact still procurement@taktboard.com?

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the SDK change — helps a lot. Looking forward to the sync notes tomorrow.

Sam
